rca_of_issue: Pydantic model defines id = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(ObjectId()), alias='_id'). model_dump(by_alias=True) before insert_one stores _id as a STRING in MongoDB. All read paths then call find_one({'_id': ObjectId(agent_id)}) which queries for a BSON ObjectId — no document matches the string-stored _id, so every lookup-by-id returns 404. Reproduction: curl POST /api/seed then curl GET /api/agents/<id from list> -> 404. Mitigation: either (a) use ObjectId() (not str-wrapped) in default_factory so Mongo gets real ObjectIds, or (b) drop ObjectId() conversion at query sites and just query by string id throughout (consistent with the str type used for agent_a_id/agent_b_id in Battle model).
